title: Pathing Plus
description: Plan your route before you commit. Pin map nodes to compare the routes through them, see a table of what each route offers (elites, fires, chests...), and zoom out to view the whole map at once. Works with mouse or controller. Informational only.
changeNote: v0.11.0 - The Legend shows selection clearly now: a locked route column fills with its route's color, a hovered one darkens. The panel sizes itself to its contents and shows plain type names when there are no routes to tabulate. Route picking is smarter: with up to ten routes surviving, the best five are shown (pin coverage first, then elites + fires, then ? nodes). The rotated view keeps the map to the left 85% of the screen so the boss end stays visible.
